Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]

## Relentless innovation from the leaders in glucose health 

Dexcom has set the standard in glucose biosensing for 25 years and counting. Our best-in-class
technologies empower people to know what is happening in their bodies in real time, helping them to
better understand the many factors that impact their glucose and overall health.
Smart devices sold separately.^{‡}
* [Explore our portfolio][5]
[two people smiling in the park one wearing the Dexcom G7 sensor]
[Dexcom G7 sensor]

## Dexcom G7 and Dexcom G7 15 Day—the world's most powerful CGM systems²

Dexcom G7 CGM Systems deliver proven results^{3-7} with best-in-class accuracy² and a growing
ecosystem of connected partners that help ease the burden of living with diabetes. They’re designed
for all types of diabetes, sending glucose numbers to your phone^{*} or receiver in real time,
giving you the knowledge to better control diabetes for healthier tomorrows.^{8,9}
* [Explore Dexcom G7][6]
[Man walking outside while wearing Stelo sensor]
[Stelo sensor]

## Stelo Glucose Biosensor

Get 24/7 insights into how food, exercise, stress, and sleep affect your body, so you can build
habits that power lasting health.^{10,11}
No prescription. FSA/HSA eligible.
* [Learn more][7]
[Woman walking with a friend outside while wearing sensor]

## Empowering people to take control of health 

Since 1999, Dexcom has been developing innovative technology that has transformed how people manage
diabetes and track their glucose. We think of ourselves as partners in their journey, empowering
them to live confidently and take control of their health with our life-changing products.
* [More about Dexcom][8]


### Get Started with Dexcom

Take the first step towards better health! Glucose health is a critical part of overall health, and
Dexcom has the best sensing solution for you or your loved one regardless of your health goals.
We'll make getting started easy from the comfort of your home.
*For Stelo app compatibility information, visit [stelo.com/compatibility][9]. For Dexcom G7
compatible devices, visit dexcom.com/compatibility.

## Relentless innovation from the leaders in glucose health 

Dexcom has set the standard in glucose biosensing for 25 years and counting. Our best-in-class
technologies empower people to know what is happening in their bodies in real time, helping them to
better understand the many factors that impact their glucose and overall health.
Smart devices sold separately.^{‡}

[two people smiling in the park one wearing the Dexcom G7 sensor]
[Dexcom G7 sensor]

## Dexcom G7 and Dexcom G7 15 Day—the world's most powerful CGM systems²

Dexcom G7 CGM Systems deliver proven results^{3-7} with best-in-class accuracy² and a growing
ecosystem of connected partners that help ease the burden of living with diabetes. They’re designed
for all types of diabetes, sending glucose numbers to your phone^{*} or receiver in real time,
giving you the knowledge to better control diabetes for healthier tomorrows.^{8,9}
* [Explore Dexcom G7][6]
[Man walking outside while wearing Stelo sensor]
[Stelo sensor]

## Stelo Glucose Biosensor

Get 24/7 insights into how food, exercise, stress, and sleep affect your body, so you can build
habits that power lasting health.^{10,11}
No prescription. FSA/HSA eligible.
* [Learn more][7]
[Woman walking with a friend outside while wearing sensor]

Since 1999, Dexcom has been developing innovative technology that has transformed how people manage
diabetes and track their glucose. We think of ourselves as partners in their journey, empowering
them to live confidently and take control of their health with our life-changing products.
* [More about Dexcom][8]

Dexcom has the best sensing solution for you or your loved one regardless of your health goals.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

# About Afon Technology

Afon Technology is a medical device business on a mission to develop** Glucowear™**, a completely
non-invasive, continuous blood glucose monitor. Glucowear™ will empower people with diabetes with
the information they need to better manage their condition on a daily basis.
* Non-Invasive Glucose Monitoring
* Continuous Glucose Monitor
* Accurate Blood Glucose Readings

## Poised to revolutionise blood glucose monitoring

Afon Technology Ltd is poised to revolutionise blood glucose monitoring, offering Glucowear as a
continuous, pain-free and real-time solution for individuals with diabetes and those at risk.
Glucowear addresses the critical challenges with the current monitoring landscape, empowering people
with diabetes to better manage their condition.

Afon is making significant progress as we enter clinical trials ahead of our anticipated launch in
2026. This is an exciting phase that brings us closer to delivering an innovative solution for the
diabetes market.

Stay tuned for more news as it happens, and thank you for your continued support and interest in our
journey.

[Glucowear][19] will reinvent diabetes management from a medicalised “patient” centric positioning
to one of freedom from the disease; be proactive and empowered and manage their condition with a
fun, fashionable, lifestyle accessory.

[“Glucowear™ device shown in a teal-coloured watch-like device with no watch face. It sits in a
white packaging box inside the charger complete with instructions. The lid of the box is displayed
above which is white with the “Glucowear™ logo on it. It has a smartphone nearby showing the
"Glucowear" app home screen.]
[Dr Sabih Chaudhry, Dr John Shillingford and Dr Muhammad Qureshi stand around a man in a white lab
coat who is showing them something under a bright light. We can’t see what the object is. The people
are all standing in a white room with lots of tools, tape and clipboards hanging over workbenches.]

## Our History

Afon Technology has come a long way since the concept of its life changing technology was discovered
in by Dr Sabih Chaudhry (Founder & CEO).

Dr Chaudhry worked with the Royal Liverpool Hospital in 2013 to conduct the first trials on the
technology and was also awarded the Bionow Award for Healthcare Project of the Year in 2014.

Since then, Dr Chaudhry has secured further private investment as well as being awarded grant
funding and has built up a team of skilled and dedicated staff who have developed the technology for
manufacture and are preparing for commercialisation.

The team at Afon Technology consists of world-renowned experts as well as people who are passionate
about improving the lives of others.

Afon Technology have carried out several independent clinical trials with their Glucowear™ device
which includes an ongoing NHS trial.

In December 2022, Afon Technology were awarded a €2.5m grant from the European Innovation Council.
Afon were one of only six UK based winners to be awarded this prestigious prize funding from amongst
thousands of applicants across Europe. This grant is designed to help individual start-ups and small
companies to develop and scale up game changing innovations.

[Регистрация отечественных медицинских изделий]

### Регистрация медицинских изделий

Проведение государственной процедуры, которая подтверждает должное качество, высокую безопасность и
эффективность различных товаров, подлежащих реализации на территории РФ.

[Государственная регистрация медицинских изделий по национальным правилам РФ]

### Сертификация медицинских изделий

Обязательная процедура, которая заключается в проведении необходимых лабораторных исследований и
составлении разрешительных документов, гарантирующих качество и безопасность реализуемой продукции.

[Лицензирование медицинских изделий и услуг]

### Лицензирование медицинских изделий и услуг

Получение лицензии, которая дает право на изготовление того или иного продукта и его техническое
обслуживание, а также позволяет заниматься определенным видом деятельности.

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

[ Donate Today ][150] [  Learn more ][151]
Image
[Woman sitting, eyes closed, hand on forehead, looking distressed.]
Image
[Diabetes Prevention]

[ Diabetes Prevention ][152]

Image
[prediabetes speedometer]

[ Prediabetes ][153]

Image
[checklist]

[ Newly Diagnosed ][154]

Image
[Type 1 person icon]

[ Type 1 Diabetes ][155]

Image
[Type 2 person icon]

[ Type 2 Diabetes ][156]

Image
[watch with heart icon]

[ Life with Diabetes ][157]

Image
[Medical bag]

[ Diabetes Complications ][158]

the good fight

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

[play video]

## What's Happening?

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

[
Image
[Graphic: US map showing state-level diabetes indicator. TX, CA, OH highest; ND, SD lowest.]
][159]
advocacy

### Advocate for Affordable Insulin Now

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

[ Sign the Petition ][160]
[
Image
[Smiling family of four wearing shirts that say "Diabetes Warrior" and "Beat Diabetes."]
][161]
SHOP DIABETES

### Save up to 25% off on official ADA merchandise

Save up to 25% on official American Diabetes Association® (ADA) merchandise! Shop T-shirts, along
with other apparel, accessories, and ADA gear. Prices are as marked.

[ Shop Now ][162]
[
Image
[Smiling African American woman in workout gear]
][163]
Diabetes Prevention

### Take Steps to Prevent Type 2 Diabetes

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore
expert-backed tools and programs to help you lower your risk for type 2 diabetes. 

[ I Can Do It ][164]
[
Image
[American Diabetes Association Scientific Sessions 2026 logo]
][165]
meetings

### 2026 Scientific Sessions

Register for on-demand access to content from the 2026 Scientific Sessions, available through August
10. Watch presentations on your schedule and earn up to 240+ CME/CE credits.

[ Register Now ][166]
[
Image
[Diabetes Technology Meeting DTM 2026]
][167]
MEETINGS

### Diabetes Technology Meeting

Explore breakthroughs in CGM, AI, and diabetes devices at the 2026 Diabetes Technology Meeting (DTM)
in Washington, DC.

[ Register Today ][168]
[
Image
[Three smiling girls in orange helmets and harnesses at an ADA diabetes day camp.]
][169]
camp

### ADA Camp Registration is Open

Explore our camp experiences designed to build confidence, independence, and connection—while
creating friendships and memories that last a lifetime. 

[ Learn More ][170]
[
Image
[Old photograph of American Diabetes Association founders]
][171]
about us

### 85 Years of Progress

Since 1940, the ADA^{ }has been a relentless force for progress—advocating, educating, and funding
groundbreaking research.

[ Learn More ][172]
[
Image
[ate_resource_card_whats_happening]
][173]
Ask the Experts

### Your Diabetes Questions Answered

Ask the Experts helps people living with diabetes tackle commonly faced issues by providing a
community where you can put your questions to our diabetes experts on a variety of topics.

[ Learn More ][174]
[
Image
[Heavy set woman on treadmill]
][175]
Take Action

### Access to Obesity Treatment

More than 50 percent of new cases of diabetes every year are linked to obesity. 
 

[ Learn More ][176]
[
Image
[Two people on a podcast]
][177]
Podcasts

### Diabetes Day by Day

A podcast for people with diabetes and their caregivers, listen in for practical advice on
overcoming everyday challenges of living with diabetes.

[ Listen to Diabetes Day by Day ][178]
[
Image
[African American woman preparing salad in kitchen]
][179]
Meal Planning

### Control Your Meals

Get tools to help with diabetes and kidney-friendly meal planning.

[ Shop Now ][180]

## Diabetes By-the-Numbers

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40
million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans had diabetes in 2023

115+M

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

[ Become a Diabetes Advocate ][181] [ Share Your Story ][182]
[
Image
[Photo of Alex Park with her diabetes tech visible. ]
][183]

### Meet Alex

Learn how Alexandra Park manages her type 1 diabetes while busy as an actress, writer, and
producer! 

[ Read Her Story ][184]
[
Image
[Photo of Alex Park with her diabetes tech visible. ]
][185]

### Meet Alex

Learn how Alexandra Park manages her type 1 diabetes while busy as an actress, writer, and
producer! 

[ Read Her Story ][186]

## Are you at risk?

Learning your risk is the first step in taking action against type 2 diabetes. Take our 60-Second
Type 2 Diabetes Risk Test today to receive actionable next steps in your health journey.

[ Take the Test ][187]
[ Learn About Prediabetes ][188]

## Life with Diabetes

Whether you're newly diagnosed, have been living with type 1 for years, or are helping out a loved
one, the path to understanding diabetes starts here.
* [Newly Diagnosed][189]
* [Living with Type 1][190]
* [Living with Type 2][191]

[ Learn More ][192]

[Smiling senior couple taking selfie in a park]

## Health & Wellness

Find  the tools, tips, and insights you need to take action and live life to the fullest—from
understanding your prescriptions to starting a new exercise regimen.

* [Weight Manageme

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

[ Donate Today ][150] [  Learn more ][151]

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

[play video]

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

## Diabetes By-the-Numbers

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40
million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans had diabetes in 2023

115+M

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.

[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

# **The smallest steps **can make the biggest impact.

FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems let you see what affects your glucose so
you can achieve small, personal wins that can add up to progress. And can help you lower your
A1c^{[39][100],[27][101]}.
[ Discover Our Products ][102]
[ Sign Up Now ][103]
[a woman outdoors wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor while stretching her leg on a park bench.]
[A yellow butterfly icon with a hole is cut into the bottom of the right wing of the butterfly to
serve as a portal.]

## **The #1 sensor worldwide^{[1][104]}.**

FreeStyle Libre systems continuously measure your glucose and helps you understand how food, sleep,
and exercise can affect your glucose. So, you can manage your diabetes with more
confidence^{[7][105]}.

## **New to continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)?
## Here’s how it works.**

FreeStyle Libre CGM systems are a painless^{[4][106]} way to see your glucose levels without finger
pricks^{[10][107]}. A small, discreet^{[2][108]} wearable sensor sends your glucose data to your
app^{[12][109]} or reader^{[213][110]} with accurate^{[2][111]} readings every minute.
[A close-up of the back of someone’s arm wearing a FreeStyle Libre sensor with an arrow pointing to
a phone displayng the FreeStyle Libre app.]

## **Daily glucose spike at lunchtime.
## See a pattern here?**

Wonder why your glucose dips at a certain time of day? Or what foods cause a spike? FreeStyle Libre
CGMs show you how meals, workouts, and medication can impact your glucose. These unique patterns can
help identify what you’re doing right and areas you can improve upon.
[ Get The Details ][112]
[ A healthy plate of pasta and marinara sauce. Above the plate is a phone showing a glucose spike on
the FreeStyle Libre app.]

[Yug Sharma]
[Graphic of the yellow brand butterfly.]

### is that my parents worry less."

information on how foods could impact your glucose levels. Generative artificial intelligence may
not always be accurate, and it should not be used to make treatment decisions.

systems. Please check the Support section of our website for more information about device
compatibility before using the apps. Use of the FreeStyle Libre systems apps may require
registration with LibreView.

which depends on sensor readings and factors like activity, stress, medication, and alcohol.

|| Personalized food suggestions are based on food preference information inputted by the user.

to FreeStyle Libre 3 and 2 systems, as feature sets are similar as FreeStyle Libre 14 day system,
excluding alarms.

# Based on pharmacy claims for the aggregate of patients covered by Commercial insurance, Managed
Medicare, Managed Medicaid using the FreeStyle Libre personal CGM systems versus Dexcom CGM systems.

may or may not be lower than other CGM systems, depending on the amount covered by insurance, if
any.

see Check Blood Glucose symbol during the first twelve hours.

professionals to assist people with diabetes and their healthcare professionals in the review,
analysis, and evaluation of historical glucose meter data to support effective diabetes management.

for professional healthcare advice.

or high glucose event and/or making a treatment decision, resulting in injury. If glucose reading

glucose meter for treatment decisions. Get medical attention when appropriate. Abbott Customer
Service at 855-632-8658 or visit [FreeStyleLibre.us][77] for safety info.

BY:

[POISONED USA: Medical Sterilizer Exposed Thousands to Cancer-Causing Chemical]
Sterilization Services of Virginia last year received a presidential exemption from EPA rules that
would have required the company to update its equipment and use a continuous emissions monitoring
system. In April, a faulty valve on the roof of its facility in Henrico County emitted more than 500
pounds of carcinogenic ethylene oxide. Residents say they weren’t notified of the release.

[Datadog’s Big New Customer: Anthropic]
Datadog told Wall Street it had landed an eight-figure deal with "one of the largest AI foundational
model companies" — but didn't say which one. Hunterbrook found Datadog's monitoring software
embedded across Claude sessions and products, with public bug reports dating back to January and a
leaked source map suggesting a much deeper rollout may be ahead. If the biggest new logo in
Datadog's history is who we think it is, the consumption-priced contract could scale directly with
Anthropic's growth.

[Zombie Pipeline: Why Sable is Still a Pipe Dream]
Exxon spinoff Sable Offshore faces seven barriers to restarting its pipeline, idled since a major
oil spill in 2015. One of those approvals needs to come from the California Coastal Commission,
which Sable CEO Jim Flores criticized for its “Teflon" “eco-Nazi attitude” in a leaked call
recording newly obtained by Hunterbrook. Because of these barriers — and despite Trump
Administration intervention — Sable’s project, originally scheduled to go online in Jan 2024, may
never sell oil. At least not under the ownership of Sable ($SOC), which is quickly running out of

[POISONED USA: Medical Sterilizer Exposed Thousands to Cancer-Causing Chemical]
Sterilization Services of Virginia last year received a presidential exemption from EPA rules that
would have required the company to update its equipment and use a continuous emissions monitoring
system. In April, a faulty valve on the roof of its facility in Henrico County emitted more than 500
pounds of carcinogenic ethylene oxide. Residents say they weren’t notified of the release.

[Sam Koppelman][23]
[Datadog’s Big New Customer: Anthropic]
Datadog told Wall Street it had landed an eight-figure deal with "one of the largest AI foundational
model companies" — but didn't say which one. Hunterbrook found Datadog's monitoring software
embedded across Claude sessions and products, with public bug reports dating back to January and a
leaked source map suggesting a much deeper rollout may be ahead. If the biggest new logo in
Datadog's history is who we think it is, the consumption-priced contract could scale directly with
Anthropic's growth.

## Zombie Pipeline: Why Sable is Still a Pipe Dream

January 23, 2026 11:00 AM
^{ EST}
BY:
[Till Daldrup][75]
[Jacob Hutt][76]
EDITOR:
[Sam Koppelman][77]
[Zombie Pipeline: Why Sable is Still a Pipe Dream]
Exxon spinoff Sable Offshore faces seven barriers to restarting its pipeline, idled since a major
oil spill in 2015. One of those approvals needs to come from the California Coastal Commission,
which Sable CEO Jim Flores criticized for its “Teflon" “eco-Nazi attitude” in a leaked call
recording newly obtained by Hunterbrook. Because of these barriers — and despite Trump
Administration intervention — Sable’s project, originally scheduled to go online in Jan 2024, may
never sell oil. At least not under the ownership of Sable ($SOC), which is quickly running out of
cash.

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. # Non-Invasive
# Continuous Glucose Monitoring

[Watch The KnowU Video][7]

## Transforming Non-Invasive Medical Diagnostics

Know Labs' proprietary non-invasive diagnostic technology platform uses radio waves to identify and
measure a wide range of organic and inorganic materials, molecules, and compositions of matter.

### Form Factor Agnostic

A technology platform that can be integrated into a variety of wearable, mobile or bench-top form
factors.

### 100+ Diagnostic Applications

Has the potential to identify and measure different molecules in and out of the the body, such as
glucose, oxygen, alcohol, metabolized drugs, and further industrial applications.

### Pain- & Waste-Free

No needles nor invasive transmitters in your body. Expensive supplies, such as test strips and
lancets, are not required. 

### Affordable

3x-5x less expensive than current blood glucose monitoring options on the market. 

[Desk Laptop]

## “The holy grail of the medical industry and patient care.”

## James H Anderson Jr., MD, FFPM, FACE
## Chief Medical Officer, Know Labs
## Former Senior Medical Director, Diabetes and CardioMetabolic Medicine, Eli Lilly and Company

## Products

Know Labs is developing products that can non-invasively identify and measure molecules in and out
of the body.
 

The KnowU is a non-invasive, wearable continuous blood glucose monitor designed to improve how 2
billion people with diabetes and pre-diabetes manage their conditions.

[Ipad screen viewing Know Labs video]
[KNOWLABS_GEN_2_MARKETING_RENDERING]

## KnowU
## Continuous & Wearable

## TM

The KnowU can be worn with an adhesive, so you can clip the sensor on and off, or on the wrist or
forearm with a strap.


The KnowU will last for years, eliminate costly disposables, have a rechargeable battery, and
connect with an easy-to-use companion mobile app. 

[Learn More][8]
[GlucoseDashboard mobile application]

## Mobile Companion App

Check your blood glucose level in real-time, and your trends over time.



 

## The Know Labs Difference

### Global Innovator

* Attempting to ease the burden of diabetes management through automation technology.

## Nightscout xDrip+

[Download latest APK][1]  

[Nightly snapshots][2]
[Source repository][3]

> Personal research version of xDrip

* Voice, Keypad or Watch input of Treatments (Insulin/Carbs/Notes)
* Visualization of Insulin and Carb action curves + Undo/Redo
* Improved alerts and predictive low forecasting feature
* Instant data synchronization between phones and tablets
* Support for many different data sources
* Published by the Nightscout Foundation

Full Nightscout Sync via NS-Client

Multiple Language Support
[Tasker Scripting Plugin]
Tasker Scripting Plugin
[All Parakeet Features Integrated]
All Parakeet Features Integrated


## The Parakeet

The Parakeet is a portable home-built device which receives wireless signals from a commercial
continuous G4 glucose sensor worn on the body. It transmits these over the phone network to a
private or cloud internet server. It does not work with the later G5 and G6 transmitters.

The Parakeet is primarily designed to allow parents and carers to be able to monitor the blood sugar
of a diabetic child even if they are a long distance away, for example, carried in the pocket of a
school bag. The real-time blood sugar information would be available on the parent’s mobile phone —
potentially many miles away.

* [Download Parakeet software (ZIP)][4]  
* [Parakeet & Google App Engine Guide (PDF)][5]
* [Parakeet Github Project Page][6]
* [Parakeet beak case and circuit board][7]  
* [Download source code (ZIP)][8]
* [Parakeet Advanced Setup (PDF)][9]

## Whole house receiver coverage

Using multiple Raspberry Pi silent mini-computers combined with Wixel receivers we can achieve
blanket coverage of the whole house. It is no longer necessary to carry a CGM receiver or remain in
range of one when at home. The signals can be collated and interpreted by these networked machines.

* [Raspberry Pi USB Wixel Project Page][10]
* [Download source code ZIP][11]

USB Wixels can use the Parakeet codebase, simply set `use_gsm = 0` when compiling.

## Automation Systems

Sophisticated forward prediction and anomaly detection systems, linked with internet connectivity,
make it possible to provide alerts and computer based analysis intelligently. This can
minimize “alarm fatigue” and reduce the mental burden of constantly tracking blood sugars.

**Just about anything is possible once we have open interoperation of the glucose sensor data.**

Currently there is active testing of systems which produce alerts based on sensor heuristics and
probability tuned predictions of what is likely to be occurring at a given moment. Machine learning
systems which can interpolate a lifetime of blood glucose data, detect anomalies and escalate alerts
as needed.

These may range from a simple ambient lighting change indicating a blood sugar prediction right up
to an emergency call out to friends and family if the diabetic becomes unresponsive.



### Contact Information

To contact me, with questions or for commercial work you can reach me via email jamorham /at/
gmail.com

## The Parakeet

The Parakeet is a portable home-built device which receives wireless signals from a commercial
continuous G4 glucose sensor worn on the body. It transmits these over the phone network to a
private or cloud internet server. It does not work with the later G5 and G6 transmitters.

The Parakeet is primarily designed to allow parents and carers to be able to monitor the blood sugar
of a diabetic child even if they are a long distance away, for example, carried in the pocket of a
school bag. The real-time blood sugar information would be available on the parent’s mobile phone —
potentially many miles away.

* [Download Parakeet software (ZIP)][4]  
* [Parakeet & Google App Engine Guide (PDF)][5]
* [Parakeet Github Project Page][6]
* [Parakeet beak case and circuit board][7]  
* [Download source code (ZIP)][8]
* [Parakeet Advanced Setup (PDF)][9]

## Whole house receiver coverage

Using multiple Raspberry Pi silent mini-computers combined with Wixel receivers we can achieve
blanket coverage of the whole house. It is no longer necessary to carry a CGM receiver or remain in
range of one when at home. The signals can be collated and interpreted by these networked machines.

* [Raspberry Pi USB Wixel Project Page][10]
* [Download source code ZIP][11]

USB Wixels can use the Parakeet codebase, simply set `use_gsm = 0` when compiling.

## Automation Systems

Sophisticated forward prediction and anomaly detection systems, linked with internet connectivity,
make it possible to provide alerts and computer based analysis intelligently. This can
minimize “alarm fatigue” and reduce the mental burden of constantly tracking blood sugars.

**Just about anything is possible once we have open interoperation of the glucose sensor data.**

Currently there is active testing of systems which produce alerts based on sensor heuristics and
probability tuned predictions of what is likely to be occurring at a given moment. Machine learning
systems which can interpolate a lifetime of blood glucose data, detect anomalies and escalate alerts
as needed.

These may range from a simple ambient lighting change indicating a blood sugar prediction right up
to an emergency call out to friends and family if the diabetic becomes unresponsive.

gmail.com

EasyPatch App

The first app that lets you control a commercially available tubeless insulin pump with your
smartphone.
* Smartphone control for your tubeless Insulin Pump

[LEARN MORE ][70]
[Touchcare Nano Insulin Pump 01] [Touchcare Nano Hybrid Closed Loop System 01]

TouchCare Nano Pump
* The world’s smallest* 200U patch pump
* World’s 1st 300U tubeless patch pump
* Waterproof** and Discreet
* Option to integrate with Nano CGM
* Smartphone control option

* 13.8g – 40.5mm X 31.5mm x 11.5mm
** IP28 rated up to 1 hour continuously at depth of 2.5m
[LEARN MORE ][71]
[Touchcare Nano Insulin Pump 02] [Touchcare Nano Insulin Pump 03]

TouchCare Nano CGM

Continuous Glucose Monitoring
* Small sensor measures glucose readings and automatically transmits information to smart device
* Discreet, slim rechargeable transmitter
* Affordable/Cost-effective and flexible starter pack options for self-funders

[LEARN MORE ][72]
[Touchcare Nano CGM 01] [Touchcare Nano CGM 02]

TouchCare Nano System
* Medtrum’s automated insulin delivery system allows for 24/7 automated insulin delivery
* Automatically adjusts basal insulin delivery and delivers correction insulin to help manage high
  glucose levels
* The built-in Auto Meal Handling feature frees you from complex daily carb counting

[LEARN MORE ][73]
[Touchcare Nano Hybrid Closed Loop System 02] [Touchcare Nano Hybrid Closed Loop System 02]
About Medtrum
Medtrum is a company dedicated to simplifying the management of diabetes. We develop and deliver
medical devices that aim to meet the needs of people with diabetes, create tools to support
healthcare professionals whilst exploring the frontiers in artificial pancreas research.
Introducing Medtrum’s TouchCare Patch Pump and CGM

Introducing Medtrum’s

TouchCare Patch Pump and CGM

The wireless freedom of the tubeless pump and integrated sensor has completely changed how I
experience my day-to-day life. Now, I live, I laugh, and I manage my diabetes my own way.
——Chloë
"The biggest win: freedom. I can go out for lunch or dinner without planning my entire life around
it."
——Mariska

关于狗万app官网

# 中西合璧 联合创新 共享共赢

狗万app官网医药是一家位于中国上海的创新药物研发和商业化公司。狗万app官网医药专注于未被满足的医疗需求
，为全球患者开发全新疗法。狗万app官网医药汇聚全球医药行业高素质人才，融合全球创新技术，依托全球优势
资源，研究开发突破性的技术和产品，引领全球糖尿病医疗创新。
公司核心产品华堂宁®（多格列艾汀片，dorzagliatin，HMS5552）以葡萄糖传感器葡萄糖激酶为靶点，提升2型糖
尿病患者的葡萄糖敏感性，改善患者血糖稳态失调，于2022年9月30日获得中国国家药品监督管理局（NMPA）的上
市批准，用于单独用药或者与二甲双胍联合用药，治疗成人2型糖尿病。对于肾功能不全患者，无需调整剂量，是
一款可用于肾功能损伤的2型糖尿病患者的口服降糖药物。

# 血糖稳态新理念

[&]

##### 正常人

健康人体血糖波动变化范围维持在约4~6.5mmol/L，并通过多种途径共同调控，称为人体血糖稳态。葡萄糖激酶激
活剂（GK）感受人体血糖变化，保护血糖稳态，是人体血糖稳态的传感器。

关于狗万app官网

# 中西合璧 联合创新 共享共赢

狗万app官网医药是一家位于中国上海的创新药物研发和商业化公司。狗万app官网医药专注于未被满足的医疗需求
，为全球患者开发全新疗法。狗万app官网医药汇聚全球医药行业高素质人才，融合全球创新技术，依托全球优势
资源，研究开发突破性的技术和产品，引领全球糖尿病医疗创新。
公司核心产品华堂宁®（多格列艾汀片，dorzagliatin，HMS5552）以葡萄糖传感器葡萄糖激酶为靶点，提升2型糖
尿病患者的葡萄糖敏感性，改善患者血糖稳态失调，于2022年9月30日获得中国国家药品监督管理局（NMPA）的上
市批准，用于单独用药或者与二甲双胍联合用药，治疗成人2型糖尿病。对于肾功能不全患者，无需调整剂量，是
一款可用于肾功能损伤的2型糖尿病患者的口服降糖药物。

# 血糖稳态新理念

[&]

##### 正常人

健康人体血糖波动变化范围维持在约4~6.5mmol/L，并通过多种途径共同调控，称为人体血糖稳态。葡萄糖激酶激
活剂（GK）感受人体血糖变化，保护血糖稳态，是人体血糖稳态的传感器。

# 中西合璧 联合创新 共享共赢

狗万app官网医药是一家位于中国上海的创新药物研发和商业化公司。狗万app官网医药专注于未被满足的医疗需求
，为全球患者开发全新疗法。狗万app官网医药汇聚全球医药行业高素质人才，融合全球创新技术，依托全球优势
资源，研究开发突破性的技术和产品，引领全球糖尿病医疗创新。
公司核心产品华堂宁®（多格列艾汀片，dorzagliatin，HMS5552）以葡萄糖传感器葡萄糖激酶为靶点，提升2型糖
尿病患者的葡萄糖敏感性，改善患者血糖稳态失调，于2022年9月30日获得中国国家药品监督管理局（NMPA）的上
市批准，用于单独用药或者与二甲双胍联合用药，治疗成人2型糖尿病。对于肾功能不全患者，无需调整剂量，是
一款可用于肾功能损伤的2型糖尿病患者的口服降糖药物。

Long before endocrine disruptors, celiac disease and generic drug quality problems were headline
news, our listeners and readers were already well informed.

More and more people are quickly becoming aware of the idea that sometimes a doctor visit is not the
only (or sometimes even the best) option for dealing with common health issues.

   │                                                                                              │ 
   │A través de su inclusión en la red SciELO, las revistas integradas en la colección            │ 
   │SciELO-México participan en las iniciativas y proyectos colaborativos dirigidos a la          │

   │colección [SciELO-México][30] en su conjunto como para cada una de las revistas en particular.│ 
   │La red SciELO también actualiza periódicamente los archivos fuente sobre métricas de las      │ 
   │revistas de todas las colecciones SciELO ([descarga de archivos][31]).                        │ 
   │                                                                                              │ 
   │Las revistas de las colecciones SciELO son indizadas en la base de datos [SciELO Citation     │ 
   │Index][32] (SciELO CI), en la plataforma Web of Science (WoS), base de datos que ofrece       │ 
   │métricas de citación internacional mediante la funcionalidad de la interfaz de la plataforma  │ 
   │WoS. Los indicadores Scimago Journal & Country Rank para las revistas de las colecciones      │ 
   │SciELO están agrupados [en este sitio][33]. ScienceOpen es otra fuente alternativa de         │ 
   │indicadores alternativos y de citación a nivel de artículo, la cual está disponible en        │ 
   │[SciELO-México/ScienceOpen][34], así como el repositorio europeo [OpenAire][35] y el          │ 
   │metabuscador [BASE][36]. Los artículos de la colección SciELO-México también son indizados en │ 
   │los índices [AGRIS][37], [CLASE][38], [PERIÓDICA][39], [BIBLAT][40], [DIALNET][41] y          │ 
   │[HAPI][42].                                                                                   │ 
   │                                                                                              │ 
   │En materia de Ciencia Abierta, el sistema SciELO desarrolla un [repositorio de preprints][43] │ 
   │y un [repositorio de datos][44], los cuales no son exclusivos de revistas incluidas en las    │ 
   │colecciones SciELO (esto es, pueden participar autores de trabajos no publicados en revistas  │ 
   │SciELO).                                                                                      │

uda│consulta:                                                                                     │ 
   │                                                                                              │ 
   │**Revistas**. A través de listas de títulos, de materias, o una opción de búsqueda avanzada   │ 
   │por los elementos principales de cada revista: palabras en el título, materias, editorial y   │ 
   │lugar de publicación.                                                                         │ 
   │                                                                                              │ 
   │**Artículos**. Proporciona acceso al texto completo de los documentos a través de un índice de│ 
   │autores, de materias (palabras clave/keywords), o una opción de búsqueda avanzada que permite │ 
   │combinar los principales elementos de los documentos: palabras del título, autor, materia,    │ 
   │resumen y año de publicación.                                                                 │ 
   │                                                                                              │ 
   │El portal www.scielo.org integra y provee acceso a la red de sitios SciELO, se pueden realizar│

The Sibionics monitor showed far better accuracy. > > Doug > > United Kingdom > ★★★★★ > > I have been using Sibionics GS 1 for 2 months, and it has amazed me with its data precision. > Thanks to Sibionics, I have reduced my hypoglycemia. > > Luca > > Italy ## Optimize Your Glucose Management ### Discover what YouTubers say about GS1 ❮ [视频封面] [视频封面] [视频封面] [视频封面] ❯ ### Discover More on the Blog ## FAQs What is the best way to wear the GS1 CGM? For an optimal glucose monitoring experience, we recommend wearing it on the upper back of your arm (the fatty part of the arm). It’s also good practice to bend your arm toward yourself when inserting the GS1 CGM. Avoid extending your arm straight, as this may tighten the arm’s muscles and lead to potential pain or bleeding. How long can the GS1 CGM be used? Each GS1 CGM is designed to last for 14 days to ensure optimal accuracy and a comfortable wearing experience. After 14 days of use, the SIBIONICS app will prompt you to replace the sensor with a new one. Is it painful to insert the GS1 CGM? No. The SIBIONICS GS1 sensor applicator features a dual-spring design. Compared to single-spring designs, this allows users to insert the sensor easily—with faster speed and less pain. Can I bathe, shower, swim, or exercise while wearing the CGM? Yes. The GS1 CGM sensor is waterproof and can be worn while bathing, showering, swimming, or exercising. However, the sensor must not be submerged in water deeper than 1 meter, and it must not stay underwater for more than 1 hour. Is the GS1 CGM system CE marked? Yes. The SIBIONICS GS1 CGM system obtained EU MDR CE certification in 2023. How much glucose data can be stored in the app and used for AGP reports? The latest version of the SIBIONICS app stores all data from your past sensors, which is accessed via our secure cloud database. You can select 7, 14, 30, or 90 days of glucose data to generate your AGP reports. ## Subscribe and get 5% off your first order! skin or hair. They require no scissors, tape, or clips, ensuring a fast and hassle-free
application.][50]

rapidly reducing pain and swelling. By working with your body, it does not shock or burn the skin
like ice.][54]

firm support and compression to injured limbs or joints,aiding in the healing process of injuries.

used by athletes, trainers, and physical therapists to ensure optimal performance and safety.][65]
[View More ][66]

production, sales, and customer service. We specialize in the development and manufacturing of

manufacturing equipment. Our products are widely used in medical wound care, sports protection,

US MED^{®} is America's primary choice for home delivery of quality medical supplies. Since 1996,
over 1 million satisfied members have received disease state education and medical supplies from our
highly trained customer service specialists. US MED^{®}, the largest provider of Diabetic Supplies
to the Medicare community, is licensed and accredited by Accreditation Commission for Health Care
(ACHC) and maintains an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau. We provide all products necessary
to treat the [Diabetes disease][141] state, including therapies for its associated comorbidities.
Our product portfolio includes, but is not limited to, the following: [Diabetic testing
strips][142], [Continuous Glucose Monitors or CGMs][143], Insulin Pumps, Sleep Apnea and CPAP
supplies, and Nebulizers.

US MED^{®} is America's primary choice for home delivery of quality medical supplies. Since 1996,
over 1 million satisfied members have received disease state education and medical supplies from our
highly trained customer service specialists. US MED^{®}, the largest provider of Diabetic Supplies
to the Medicare community, is licensed and accredited by Accreditation Commission for Health Care
(ACHC) and maintains an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau. We provide all products necessary
to treat the [Diabetes disease][141] state, including therapies for its associated comorbidities.
Our product portfolio includes, but is not limited to, the following: [Diabetic testing
strips][142], [Continuous Glucose Monitors or CGMs][143], Insulin Pumps, Sleep Apnea and CPAP
supplies, and Nebulizers.

Great technology solutions are patented.

However, finding and understanding these tech. solutions described in patents can be really
difficult.

So much so, that people don't even bother trying and highly valuable information is missed.

X-ray solves this.

X-ray makes it easy to read and understand the technology solution in the patents.

With X-ray, you innovate fast.

## How is Xray different from a patent database?

**Making patents easier to find**

In patent databases you have to find patents by keyword searching. Xray organizes patents into
categories where patents addressing same problem are already clubbed together. This makes it easy
for you to find patents of your interest.

**Making patents easier to understand**

Xray eliminates legal jargon to make patent language much more easier to understand.

Original Patent Abstract

> A battery system includes: a battery pack including a battery housing and a plurality of battery
> cells accommodated within the battery housing; and a cover element covering an outer side of the
> battery housing. The battery housing has a housing exit at where a venting gas stream exhausted by
> one or more of the battery cells during a thermal runaway exits the battery housing, and the cover
> element covers the housing exit. The cover element forms a venting channel together with the outer
> side of the battery housing such that the venting gas stream exiting the housing exit is received
> and guided by the venting channel along the outer side of the battery housing to a channel exit of
> the venting channel.

Xray Abstract

> Battery system for electric vehicles that has a unique venting system to safely exhaust gases in
> the event of a battery thermal runaway. The system uses a cover element attached to the battery
> pack housing with a venting channel to redirect and cool the hot gases. The channel has obstacles
> and curves to lengthen the path and increase contact with the cover to extract heat. This prevents
> the hot gases from rapidly exiting the pack and potentially igniting, instead cooling them before
> release.

## Why researchers should refer patents?

**Devise solutions faster**

Examining relevant patents sheds light on past attempts to tackle similar issues, helping you
understand the problem better and lower the time to solution.

**Discover new angles**

Related patents show you inventive solutions that might not cross your mind, aiding in
brainstorming, mixing ideas, and improving the ultimate solution you arrive at.

**Feel more confident**

Equipped with a thorough knowledge of the state-of-the-art, which patents provide you with, you
become more confident about your own strategy.

## How is Xray different from a patent database?

**Making patents easier to find**

In patent databases you have to find patents by keyword searching. Xray organizes patents into
categories where patents addressing same problem are already clubbed together. This makes it easy
for you to find patents of your interest.

**Making patents easier to understand**

Xray eliminates legal jargon to make patent language much more easier to understand.

> element covers the housing exit. The cover element forms a venting channel together with the outer
> side of the battery housing such that the venting gas stream exiting the housing exit is received
> and guided by the venting channel along the outer side of the battery housing to a channel exit of
